session_goals: Establish rapport and orient the patient to the session
Screen mood, sleep, appetite and concentration
ideal_guidelines.ideal_approach: Open with unstructured listening, move to structured symptom review, close with an explicit safety check and a summary.

transcript.content: Hi, thanks for coming in today. Before we start, is there anything you'd like to make sure we cover?
I don't know really. My sister said I should come. I've just been… flat, I guess.
Flat. Can you say more about what that's been like day to day?
I get up, I go to work, I come home. I used to cook a lot. I haven't done that in months. It all feels like effort.
How long would you say it's been since things started feeling that way?
Since the spring, maybe? It got worse after they restructured my team.
And how has your sleep been through that time?
I fall asleep fine. I just wake up at four and that's it, I'm awake.
That early-morning waking is something I want to come back to. First — when things have felt heaviest, have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or of not wanting to be here?
Not… like a plan. Sometimes I think it'd be easier if I didn't wake up. But I wouldn't do anything.
Thank you for telling me that. I want to ask a bit more about those thoughts — how often do they come, and has anything ever moved beyond the thought?
Maybe once a week. No, never anything more than that.
That's useful for me to know. We're near time, so let me summarise what I've heard and we can agree where to pick up next week.
